claim: The only representational difference between date::weekday and iso_week::weekday is the pair to_iso_encoding(z) = z != 0 ? z : 7 and from_iso_encoding(u) = u != 7 ? u : 0, which are mutual inverses on [0,7] and are used by the two converting constructors iso_week::weekday(date::weekday) and operator date::weekday(); iso_week::weekday::ok() is 1 <= wd_ && wd_ <= 7, so 0 is not a representable iso_week weekday at all.
